checks: empty: clear proposal has no submission
direction: saved source to target is explicit
success: no inference or apply implied
contract: explicit adoption precedes oriented relation
draft edit: old result marked obsolete
refresh: queue, fields and old result preserved as obsolete
impact: used removal shows located violations
rename: migration is suggestion requiring confirmation
error: invalid schema gives located details and preserved draft
offline: uncertain response has explicit retry
race: late response does not replace edited draft
accessibility: every form control has a label
safety: editor sends only preview POSTs
revision: preview does not pin old graph generation
